The rollout should show present, temporally smooth pendulum motion after release from the marked angle, without jitter, teleporting, or discontinuous bob/string movement.

causal_checks: When released from rest at the marked angle, gravity causes the bob to move downward toward the center.
The bob speed increases as it descends and is greatest near the lowest point.
The bob follows an arc centered on the fixed pivot because the taut string constrains its motion.
After crossing the lowest point, the bob climbs the opposite side and slows.
At the far side of the swing, the bob reverses direction instead of continuing upward indefinitely.
The swing amplitude does not exceed the initial release angle without an added push.
The pivot, frame, protractor, board, and camera remain stationary while the bob moves.
controlled_variables: measurement camera position and framing remain fixed
base board, protractor, level label, marked release angle, and apparatus anchors remain fixed
bob mass and appearance remain unchanged
release is from rest with no added impulse
expected_spec.expected_response: After release, the bob accelerates downward along a circular arc about the fixed pivot, passes through the lowest vertical position at maximum speed, rises on the opposite side to a comparable but not greater height, then reverses and continues oscillating. The string stays taut and attached, and the bob remains constrained to the pendulum arc rather than translating freely. Any damping should be gradual if present.
failure_modes: bob receives an obvious push or starts with nonzero impulse
bob falls straight down or detaches from the string
string stretches, goes slack unnaturally, changes length, or disconnects
pivot or frame moves with the pendulum
bob path is linear, random, or not centered on the pivot
bob exceeds the starting height or angle without external input
apparatus, labels, protractor, or camera drift during the rollout
pendulum motion lacks plausible acceleration, slowdown, reversal, or periodicity
